title: Choosing athletic footwear
publisher: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
claims: The foot stretches about 5 mm between standing and walking.
Leave a thumb's width between the end of the longest toe and the end of the shoe.
The toe box should be deep enough not to press on the tops of the toes, and the front should be round or square rather than pointed.
Shoes should contain six or more eyelets so the fit can be adjusted with laces.
Padding at the inside of the heel helps hold the foot back in the shoe and make room for the toes.
The sole should be wider than the ball of the foot.
